about: Curated points for places whose OpenStreetMap outline gives a misleading point. Keyed by the OSM reference stored in the index (r = relation, w = way, n = node). The point replaces the computed one at build time (scripts/places/build_places.py) and at search time (lib/places.mjs), so an index built before an anchor was added is still correct. Each point is the location of a named OSM feature, given in source.

r2814221.name: University of California, Berkeley
r2814221.reason: The campus relation includes the hill lands east of the main campus, so its representative point fell in the Berkeley Hills inside Oakland.
